run_xarm6_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation of an XArm6 robot arm with inverse kinematics and joint control
create_xarm6_sim_instance: create an XArm6Sim instance with a pybullet client and position offset to load the robot URDF
step_xarm_simulation: step the XArm6 simulation forward using inverse kinematics to move the end effector along a sinusoidal path
configure_pybullet_environment: configure a pybullet environment with a 60Hz timestep, gravity, and URDF search path for robot simulation
review_xarm6_sim_class: review the XArm6Sim class that loads the XArm6 URDF, sets up joints, and performs inverse kinematics each step
